steps.prompt: Before the check: which kind of number theory problem do you solve fastest now, and which one do you still have to stop and think about?

cards.title: Remainders, units digits, bases: quick review
cards.body: Replace numbers by their remainders before adding or multiplying, and reduce at the end. Units digits are remainders mod $10$; powers cycle with length $1$, $2$ or $4$, and remainder $0$ means the end of the cycle. In base $b$ the places are $1, b, b^2, \ldots$ and digits go up to $b - 1$.

cards.title: Digits & integer equations: quick review
cards.body: A two-digit number is $10a + b$, and minus its reversal it is $9(a - b)$. For $ax + by = c$, find one solution and step. For $xy + ax + by = c$, add a constant and factor; $a^2 - b^2 = (a - b)(a + b)$. Check positive, ordered and digit limits.

cards.title: How the check works
cards.body: First a short warm-up. Then the check: $8$ AMC-style problems with choices, easiest first, no hints. You need all $8$ right (100%) to pass. If you miss one, you'll see the solutions and which skills to review, and the next try gives you new problems. Passing opens checkpoint mock 1.

prompts: Which habit from this unit will you use first on your next test?
Which skill will you keep practising in the daily review?
